nodes.label: HIG Foundations of Design
nodes.rationale: Core design pillars encompassing accessibility, app icons, color, layout, materials, and typography across Apple platforms.

nodes.label: HIG Structural Topics Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Organizational framework categorizing guidelines into Foundations, Patterns, Components, Inputs, and Technologies.

nodes.label: Apple Hardware Input Modalities
nodes.rationale: Survey of physical user input controls across Apple ecosystem including Action button, Apple Pencil, Camera Control, Digital Crown, and keyboards.

nodes.label: Spatial, Eye, and Hand Tracking Inputs
nodes.norm_label: spatial, eye, and hand tracking inputs
nodes.rationale: Gaze target identification via eyes combined with subtle direct and indirect finger gestures in visionOS.

nodes.label: Full Keyboard Access (FKA)
nodes.rationale: Systemwide accessibility feature enabling complete navigation and activation of windows, menus, and controls via physical keyboard.

nodes.label: Keyboard Shortcuts and Modifier Ordering
nodes.rationale: Standard modifier key sequence (Control, Option, Shift, Command) with automatic layout mirroring and localization in RTL environments.

nodes.label: visionOS Physical Keyboard Accessory Overlay
nodes.rationale: visionOS renders a virtual hovering text completion overlay above connected physical keyboards.

nodes.label: System Semantic Label Colors
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical semantic colors (label, secondaryLabel, tertiaryLabel, quaternaryLabel) signal relative information importance across platforms.

nodes.label: watchOS Date and Timer Text Components
nodes.norm_label: watchos date and timer text components
nodes.rationale: System date and countdown timer components automatically adapt display format and update in complications without app wakeups.

nodes.label: Layout Structural and Container Components
nodes.rationale: Overview of structural views for grouping and partitioning content including boxes, collections, split views, and tab views.

nodes.label: Background Extension Effect for Sidebars
nodes.rationale: Extend and blur full-screen background imagery beneath sidebars and toolbars using background extension effects to prevent harsh cutoffs.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass Material and Scroll Edge Effects
nodes.norm_label: liquid glass material and scroll edge effects
nodes.rationale: Use Liquid Glass to elevate controls distinctively above content, avoiding solid opaque backgrounds beneath floating bars.

nodes.label: Safe Areas and Layout Guides
nodes.rationale: Layout guides standardize reading widths and margins, while safe areas ensure hardware features like Dynamic Island do not occlude UI.

nodes.label: Adaptive Size Classes (Compact and Regular)
nodes.rationale: Size classes decouple layout adaptation from specific hardware models or orientation idioms, adapting cleanly across multitasking and mirroring.

nodes.label: visionOS Window and Volume Placement
nodes.rationale: Support window resizing while maintaining centered content at large scales; reserve ornaments for controls rather than supplemental content views.

nodes.label: macOS Multicolumn Sortable Tables
nodes.rationale: Provide resizable columns, alternating row shading, and click-to-sort column headers for complex productivity data.

nodes.label: Trailing Row Elements and Alphabetic Indices
nodes.norm_label: trailing row elements and alphabetic indices
nodes.rationale: Avoid placing vertical alphabetic jump indices alongside trailing row disclosure buttons to eliminate target collision.

nodes.label: Audio Interruption Handling
nodes.rationale: Pauses indefinitely for primary audio (music/podcasts); temporarily ducks volume for transient audio (GPS).

nodes.label: visionOS Shared Space Multitasking
nodes.rationale: Only one window active at a time; inactive windows receive feathering masks and recede along z-axis with audio ducking.

nodes.label: iPadOS Windowed Multitasking
nodes.rationale: Supports full-screen and resizable window configurations with active-window drop shadows and tiling controls.

nodes.label: Audio Categories
nodes.rationale: AVAudioSession categories (solo ambient, ambient, playback, record, play and record).

nodes.label: Handling Interruptions
nodes.rationale: Managing resumable and nonresumable audio interruptions like phone calls or secondary audio.

nodes.label: Spatial Audio
nodes.rationale: Perceived 3D sound anchored to virtual objects or user surroundings in visionOS.

nodes.label: Aspect Ratio Modes
nodes.rationale: Full-screen aspect-fill vs fit-to-screen aspect modes without embedded padding.

nodes.label: Picture in Picture
nodes.rationale: Floating video playback window enabling multitasking while viewing media.

nodes.label: Transport Controls & Content Tabs
nodes.rationale: Playback controls and content tabs (info, episodes, chapters) in tvOS and visionOS.

nodes.label: TV App Integration
nodes.rationale: Seamless transitions from the TV app into content playback, resuming, and profile switching.

nodes.label: Multitasking
nodes.rationale: Allows people to switch rapidly between apps and run multiple simultaneous contexts.

nodes.label: Playing Audio
nodes.rationale: Expectations and guidelines for audio playback, rerouting, and volume management.

nodes.label: Playing Video
nodes.rationale: Providing rich, immersive video playback across platforms using system video players.

nodes.label: Custom Keyboard Shortcut Design Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Reserve custom shortcuts for high-frequency actions; avoid overloading existing conventions like undo/redo.

nodes.label: Selectable Text for Informational Labels
nodes.rationale: Allow people to select and copy static label text containing high-value data such as error details, addresses, and server endpoints.

nodes.label: Visual Hierarchy and Progressive Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Organize elements by reading order, alignment, and deliberate indentation while using progressive disclosure to keep views uncluttered.

nodes.label: Row-Based Content Scanning and Editing
nodes.rationale: Row formatting facilitates vertical reading of structured text and enables reordering, selection, and hierarchy navigation.

nodes.label: visionOS Motion and Comfort
nodes.rationale: Prevents peripheral motion, virtual world rotation, and 0.2Hz oscillation; provides stationary frames of reference and fades.

nodes.label: State and Context Preservation
nodes.rationale: Pauses active tasks when switching away, completes user tasks in background, and restores exact state upon resumption.

nodes.label: AI transparency and user control
nodes.rationale: Clear disclosure of AI usage, honest setting of capability limits, non-AI fallbacks, and affordances to refine, undo, or retry outputs.

nodes.label: Attribution
nodes.rationale: Provides underlying rationale (e.g. 'Because you read...') to establish transparency and build trust without technical jargon.

nodes.label: Calibration
nodes.rationale: Initial information-gathering step required for functionality (e.g. Face ID scan); should occur early, remain minimal, and show clear progress.

nodes.label: Confidence Communication
nodes.rationale: Translates statistical confidence into actionable suggestions or ranking rather than raw percentages to facilitate decision-making.

nodes.label: Guided and Freeform Corrections
nodes.rationale: Enables users to fix ML mistakes; guided corrections suggest alternatives, while freeform adjustments allow flexible manual refinement.

nodes.label: Explicit Feedback
nodes.rationale: Voluntary user responses to specific prompts; must clearly describe consequences, offer multiple granular options, and take effect immediately.

nodes.label: Implicit Feedback
nodes.rationale: Gleaned from user actions without asking extra work; must secure user data, prioritize recent actions, and avoid confirmation bias.

nodes.label: Multiple Options Presentation
nodes.rationale: Presents diverse, ranked choices to bridge prediction gaps and maintain user control without increasing cognitive overload.

nodes.label: App Tracking Transparency
nodes.rationale: System alert required before collecting tracking data or advertising identifiers.

nodes.label: LocationButton
nodes.rationale: Lightweight button granting one-time temporary location authorization without persistent alerts.

nodes.label: Passkeys & Biometrics
nodes.rationale: Authentication using passkeys and biometric ID (Face ID, Touch ID, Optic ID).

nodes.label: Permission Requests & Purpose Strings
nodes.rationale: Requesting protected resources in context with clear, active-voice purpose strings.

nodes.label: Pre-Alert Screens
nodes.rationale: Displaying a custom screen before system alerts with single 'Continue'/'Next' action.

nodes.label: visionOS Input Privacy
nodes.rationale: System hover feedback without exposing user gaze to apps; Full Space required for ARKit data.

nodes.label: Generative AI
nodes.rationale: Principles for integrating generative AI responsibly, preserving user agency, mitigating hallucinations, protecting privacy, and managing latency.

nodes.label: Machine Learning
nodes.rationale: Empowers apps to learn from data and usage patterns, creating personalized and dynamic user experiences.

nodes.label: Privacy Foundations
nodes.rationale: Transparency about collected data, on-device processing, and protecting user privacy.

nodes.label: Responsible AI design
nodes.rationale: Design ethos proactively mitigating biases and stereotypes, ensuring inclusivity, and requiring explicit consent before irreversible automated actions.

nodes.label: ML Limitations Management
nodes.rationale: Sets realistic expectations before use and demonstrates how to get best results, preventing perceived product defects.

nodes.label: ML Mistakes and Mitigation
nodes.rationale: Anticipates inevitable errors, matching recovery tools to mistake severity, and uses errors as learning signals without UI clutter.

nodes.label: ML Role Dimensions
nodes.rationale: Guides design decisions across 5 axes: critical vs complementary, private vs public, proactive vs reactive, visible vs invisible, dynamic vs static.

nodes.label: Action Button Hardware Interaction
nodes.rationale: Allow users to initiate core actions without leaving context using Live Activities; short verb labels (max 3 words) describe the action in Settings.

nodes.label: Action Button Secondary Action
nodes.rationale: Subsequent presses advance or support primary action without requiring looking at screen; Action + Side button pauses active sessions.

nodes.label: App Clip Card
nodes.rationale: System-provided modal presentation card displaying photo header, concise title (max 30 chars), subtitle (max 56 chars), and action verb (Open, View, Play).

nodes.label: App Clip Code
nodes.rationale: Scannable physical visual and NFC-integrated marker engineered for quick, secure App Clip invocation in physical environments.

nodes.label: Frictionless App Clip Flow
nodes.rationale: Prioritize speed and immediate utility; preserve privacy by utilizing Sign in with Apple and Apple Pay instead of requiring manual registration.

nodes.label: App Intents Framework
nodes.rationale: Programmatic interface exposing app actions, parameters, and entities to Apple Intelligence, Siri, and system automation without setup.

nodes.label: App Shortcut Voice Phrases
nodes.rationale: Concise, memorable voice invocation phrases featuring the app name and optional parameters that Siri can execute directly.

nodes.label: Auto-Renewable Subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Subscription models requiring clear presentation of pricing, renewal frequency, free trial terms, and effortless cancellation UI.

nodes.label: In-App Refund and Help UI
nodes.rationale: Empower users to report purchase problems, find previous transactions, and invoke system refund requests directly within the app.

nodes.label: Apple Pay Buttons (PKPaymentButton)
nodes.rationale: Standard payment buttons (Buy, Checkout, Donate, Subscribe, Reload) that establish visual trust and support immediate express checkout.

nodes.label: Apple Pay Payment Sheet
nodes.rationale: System authorization sheet displaying total cost, line items, shipping address, discounts, and payment methods prior to biometric confirmation.

nodes.label: Scribble Handwriting Input
nodes.rationale: System-wide handwriting conversion into standard text fields; requires stable, non-autoscrolling text containers during writing.

nodes.label: Apple Pencil Squeeze Gesture
nodes.rationale: Single, discrete pressure squeeze on Apple Pencil Pro displaying contextual tool pickers near the pencil tip for immediate access.

nodes.label: Camera Control Overlay (Slider & Picker)
nodes.rationale: Bezel-adjacent overlay offering slider (range of values like exposure) and picker (discrete options like grid) without occluding viewfinder.

nodes.label: Camera Control SF Symbols Integration
nodes.rationale: Overlay controls require standard SF Symbols from the Camera & Photos category to communicate function without custom glyphs.

nodes.label: Action Button
nodes.rationale: Physical hardware button on iPhone 15 Pro/later and Apple Watch Ultra offering instant access to frequent actions and App Shortcuts.

nodes.label: App Clips
nodes.rationale: Lightweight, on-demand mini-apps launched via NFC, QR codes, App Clip Codes, Safari, or Messages to perform an immediate task.

nodes.label: App Shortcuts
nodes.rationale: App Intents-powered shortcuts configured to surface app tasks in Spotlight, Siri, and Action button automatically upon app install.

nodes.label: Apple In-App Purchase
nodes.rationale: StoreKit-powered commerce framework for offering digital products, services, subscriptions, and content within apps.

nodes.label: Apple Pay
nodes.rationale: Secure, one-touch digital payment system using PassKit for physical goods, services, and donations in apps and on the web.

nodes.label: Apple Pencil and Scribble
nodes.rationale: High-precision stylus input system supporting drawing, annotation, squeeze, barrel roll, hover, and Scribble handwriting.

nodes.label: Camera Control
nodes.rationale: Dedicated tactile hardware control on iPhone 16 models providing direct access and adjustments for camera experiences.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Rendering Mode
nodes.rationale: Assigns different opacities of a single color to layers to create depth and visual hierarchy.

nodes.label: Symbol Rendering Modes
nodes.rationale: Four rendering modes (monochrome, hierarchical, palette, multicolor) that utilize symbol layer paths to render colors and depths appropriately.

nodes.label: Custom Spatial Templates & Seating
nodes.rationale: Design custom seating arrangements for up to 5 spatial Personas placed at least 1 meter apart, keeping seats decoupled from app functional roles.

nodes.label: Shared Activities Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Real-time synchronized experiences allowing participants to engage simultaneously in media playback, games, or whiteboard collaboration.

nodes.label: Spatial Personas Presence
nodes.rationale: 3D avatars enabling natural gaze, movement, and gestures, falling back to contact photos or 2D video windows for participants without spatial hardware.

nodes.label: visionOS Spatial Seating Templates
nodes.rationale: Predefined seating templates (side-by-side, surround, conversational) position participants around shared 3D content according to the activity type.

nodes.label: Modal vs Nonmodal Sheet Modality
nodes.rationale: Modal sheets prevent parent view interaction until dismissed; nonmodal sheets (iOS/iPadOS) allow affecting parent content concurrently while onscreen.

nodes.label: Sheet Detents & Grabber Affordance
nodes.rationale: Standard detents (large for full height, medium for progressive disclosure) with grabber providing visual and VoiceOver resizing affordance.

nodes.label: Swipe to Dismiss & Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Support vertical swipe down to dismiss, using action sheets to prompt confirmation if unsaved changes exist.

nodes.label: Depth Hierarchy & 3D Volumes
nodes.rationale: Utilize visual depth cues (reflections, shadow, receding planes) to emphasize hierarchy while avoiding visual fatigue and hovering text.

nodes.label: Dynamic vs Fixed Scaling
nodes.rationale: Dynamic scaling adjusts window size with distance so interaction stays constant; fixed scale preserves true physical object dimensions.

nodes.label: Field of View & World-Anchoring
nodes.rationale: Place primary content within the field of view; anchor content in user space rather than locking to the head to avoid confinement and nausea.

nodes.label: Sheet Navigation & Dismissal Button Placement
nodes.rationale: Pair Done with Cancel (leading) or Back; never present all three buttons together or leave Done alone without a clear exit path.

nodes.label: Indirect Gestures & Target Spacing
nodes.rationale: Prioritize indirect gestures over tiring direct reaching; maintain button center spacing >=60pt with >=16pt gap for gaze hover targeting.

nodes.label: AirPlay
nodes.rationale: Wireless streaming of media content across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS devices

nodes.label: Always On Display
nodes.rationale: System maintains continuous app interface presentation during suspended interaction states

nodes.label: App Clips
nodes.rationale: Lightweight on-the-go or demo experiences available instantly without full app installation

nodes.label: Apple In-App Purchase
nodes.rationale: Secure purchasing of digital goods, premium content, and subscriptions within apps

nodes.label: Apple Pay
nodes.rationale: Secure payment platform for physical goods, services, donations, and subscriptions

nodes.label: Augmented Reality
nodes.rationale: Blends virtual 3D objects with physical real-world environments

nodes.label: CareKit
nodes.rationale: Framework for managing medical care plans, chronic illness recovery, and wellness goals

nodes.label: CarPlay
nodes.rationale: Automotive integration displaying maps, calls, messages, and music on car dash displays

nodes.label: Game Center
nodes.rationale: Social gaming network for player progress tracking and multiplayer connectivity

nodes.label: Generative AI
nodes.rationale: Dynamic AI-driven content generation and intelligent app features

nodes.label: HealthKit
nodes.rationale: Central repository for health, biometric, and fitness data across Apple platforms

nodes.label: HomeKit
nodes.rationale: Smart home accessory control via Siri and the Home app across Apple devices

nodes.label: ID Verifier
nodes.rationale: Mobile ID reading directly on iPhone without requiring external hardware

nodes.label: Machine Learning
nodes.rationale: Adaptive models learning from usage patterns to enhance user experiences

nodes.label: SharePlay
nodes.rationale: Synchronized group media playback and shared collaborative experiences

nodes.label: ShazamKit
nodes.rationale: Audio recognition and music identification matching audio samples against catalogs

nodes.label: Siri
nodes.rationale: Voice-activated conversational assistant for queries and system task automation

nodes.label: Tap to Pay on iPhone
nodes.rationale: Contactless payment acceptance directly on iPhone without external POS terminals

nodes.label: Technologies
nodes.rationale: Catalog of Apple platform features, services, and framework integrations for apps and games

nodes.label: App Intents and Entities
nodes.rationale: AppIntents expose app capabilities (intents) and data types (entities) to Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts.

nodes.label: App Schema Domains
nodes.rationale: Preset domain templates (photos, mail, music) allowing apps to inherit system built-in logic for natural conversational flows.

nodes.label: Contextual Cues & View Annotation
nodes.rationale: Annotating views with app entities and donating recent user actions allows Siri to anticipate needs and understand onscreen references.

nodes.label: Siri AI & Apple Intelligence
nodes.rationale: Apple Intelligence powers Siri with deep conversational natural language awareness and contextual understanding of onscreen elements.

nodes.label: Confirmation vs Result Snippet Types
nodes.rationale: Confirmation snippets present primary action and Cancel buttons; result snippets present finalized status with a Done button.

nodes.label: Snippet Response View
nodes.rationale: Compact cards surfaced in Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts displaying intent execution results or requesting user confirmation.

nodes.label: Status Bar Indicator
nodes.rationale: Upper edge display of device state (time, carrier, Wi-Fi, battery); obscure underlying content using scroll edge effects to maintain legibility.

nodes.label: System Surfaces & Integration Group
nodes.rationale: Collection of integration points outside the core application window, including widgets, live activities, lock screen controls, and complications.

nodes.label: Siri Response Dialogue Design
nodes.rationale: Responses must be succinct, device-independent, inclusive, functional both visually and audibly, and omit redundant app names.

nodes.label: Visual Communication & 400pt Limit
nodes.rationale: Limit custom view height to 400pt, omit redundant visual dialogue when spoken aloud, and deep-link for expanded information.

nodes.label: Temporary Status Bar Hiding
nodes.rationale: Temporarily hide during full-screen media viewing to enhance immersion, but never permanently hide and provide a single-tap redisplay gesture.

nodes.label: Interface Icons and Glyphs
nodes.rationale: Interface icons communicate single straightforward concepts using streamlined shapes, consistent weight, and optical alignment.

nodes.label: macOS Document Icons
nodes.rationale: Document icons use the folded-corner paper shape with layered background fills, center images, and succinct extension labels.

nodes.label: visionOS 2D and Spatial Image Presentation
nodes.rationale: visionOS image views display 2D, stereoscopic, and spatial photos within windows, or RealityKit components for spatial scenes.

nodes.label: Editable macOS Image Well Interaction
nodes.rationale: An editable image view on macOS supporting copy, paste, dragging, and content deletion with fallback to default images.

nodes.label: Image Scale Factors and Display Densities
nodes.norm_label: image scale factors and display densities
nodes.rationale: Standard and high-resolution displays require distinct scale factors (@1x, @2x, @3x) mapped to points for consistent visual sizing.

nodes.label: tvOS Layered Images and Parallax Depth
nodes.norm_label: tvos layered images and parallax depth
nodes.rationale: tvOS layered images combine multiple planes of artwork with transparency to produce dynamic parallax depth upon focus.

nodes.label: visionOS Spatial Photos and Spatial Scenes
nodes.norm_label: visionos spatial photos and spatial scenes
nodes.rationale: RealityKit renders stereoscopic spatial photos with disparity metadata and generates spatial scenes with head-tracking parallax from 2D photos.

nodes.label: Live Photo Motion Hint and Visual Badging
nodes.norm_label: live photo motion hint and visual badging
nodes.rationale: Differentiate Live Photos using subtle movement hints or system badges in consistent corner positions without confusing video playback buttons.

nodes.label: Icon Visual Consistency and Weight Matching
nodes.norm_label: icon visual consistency and weight matching
nodes.rationale: Match the weights of interface icons and adjacent typography to maintain balanced visual hierarchy and level of emphasis.

nodes.label: Non-Interactive Image Display Pattern
nodes.rationale: Use image views primarily for static or non-interactive image presentation; configure buttons or image wells when interaction or editing is required.

nodes.label: Live Photo Content Integrity Principle
nodes.rationale: Preserve all frames and audio together as a singular continuous memory; never disassemble components or present them separately.

nodes.label: Assistive Access
nodes.rationale: Streamlined interface in iOS and iPadOS for cognitive disability; requires stripping nonessential workflows and confirming destructive actions twice.

nodes.label: Cognitive Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Keep actions simple, avoid auto-dismissing timed interfaces, support Reduce Motion, respond to Dim Flashing Lights, and optimize workflows for Assistive Access.

nodes.label: Hearing Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Ensure all audio content provides closed captions, visual indicators, or subtitles so deaf and hard-of-hearing users can access dialogue and non-speech sound effects.

nodes.label: Mobility and Motor Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Provide minimum target sizes (44x44 pt on iOS/watchOS, 60x60 pt on visionOS), simple gestures, and alternative onscreen controls for physical interactions.

nodes.label: Speech Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Support Full Keyboard Access, standard keyboard shortcuts, and Switch Control to empower users with speech disabilities or text preferences.

nodes.label: Vision Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Support Dynamic Type scaling by at least 200%, meet WCAG AA contrast minimums (4.5:1 text, 3:1 bold/large), prefer system colors, and never convey info with color alone.

nodes.label: CareKit UI Views (Tasks, Charts, Contacts)
nodes.rationale: Modular UI views (Task views, Chart views, Contact views) connected with CareKit Store to structure health tracking and communication.

nodes.label: Patient Health Privacy and Data Security
nodes.norm_label: patient health privacy and data security
nodes.rationale: Safeguard health data by requesting permissions contextually, presenting transparent privacy policies, and delegating sharing to iOS Settings.

nodes.label: Accessible Chart Design
nodes.rationale: Ensure charts communicate through accessibility labels, audio graphs, and descriptive summary text in addition to graphical marks.

nodes.label: Chart Simplicity and Progressive Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Avoid cluttering charts with excessive data; provide macro summaries first and let users progressively disclose details or change scope.

nodes.label: Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Accessible interfaces empower everyone to interact with apps regardless of ability by adhering to intuitive, perceivable, and adaptable design principles.

nodes.label: CareKit
nodes.rationale: Open-source healthcare app framework for tracking care plans, managing health regimens, and connecting patients with clinicians.

nodes.label: Charting Data
nodes.rationale: Design principles for presenting datasets through visual and interactive charts to communicate trends and insights clearly.

nodes.label: Game Center access point
nodes.rationale: Circular UI button leading players to the Game Overlay (iOS/macOS) or dashboard (tvOS/visionOS) from game menu screens.

nodes.label: Game Center achievements
nodes.rationale: Collectible cards tracking player accomplishments across locked, in-progress, hidden, and completed states with circular masked art.

nodes.label: Game Center challenges
nodes.rationale: Time-limited 1-5 minute multiplayer competitions built on leaderboards tracking recent performance to maintain fair competition.

nodes.label: Game Overlay
nodes.rationale: System-provided overlay in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS for viewing achievements, leaderboards, player profiles, and initiating multiplayer sessions.

nodes.label: Game Center leaderboards
nodes.rationale: Rankings tracking player scores via classic all-time boards or recurring time-limited boards, organized into thematic sets.

nodes.label: Game Center multiplayer activities
nodes.rationale: Real-time and turn-based multiplayer matchmaking coordinated via 8-character party codes or GameKit UI.

nodes.label: Spatial game controllers
nodes.rationale: visionOS controllers (e.g. PS VR2 Sense) mapped to gaze targeting with trigger presses or direct spatial reaching.

nodes.label: Virtual touch controls
nodes.rationale: Onscreen buttons and floating thumbsticks with visual glow press states, mapped to thumb ergonomics (left: movement, right: camera/actions).

nodes.label: Game Center
nodes.rationale: Apple's social gaming network supporting player progress tracking, friend invites, leaderboard competition, and cross-platform game discovery.

nodes.label: Game controls
nodes.rationale: Guidance for mapping gameplay controls across touchscreens, physical game controllers, keyboards, and spatial hand/eye controllers.

nodes.label: Selection & Input UI Group
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive collection of controls providing standard affordances for selecting values, configuring options, and entering text or data.

nodes.label: Circular Sliders
nodes.rationale: Ideal for values that wrap or repeat continuously, such as degrees of angle rotation (0 to 360 degrees).

nodes.label: Slider Control & Thumb
nodes.rationale: Horizontal track with adjustable thumb between min and max values, visually indicating filled progress track and optional endpoint icons.

nodes.label: Tick Marks & Live Feedback
nodes.rationale: Tick marks and labels in macOS linear sliders clarify scale and accuracy, providing dynamic real-time live feedback during adjustment.

nodes.label: Shift-Click Acceleration in macOS
nodes.rationale: Support Shift-click in macOS to increment values by larger multiples (e.g. 10x default) across wide ranges.

nodes.label: Stepper Control
nodes.rationale: Two-segment control to increase or decrease incremental values; paired with adjacent labels/fields since the stepper does not display values itself.

nodes.label: Slider Supplementation with Text Field and Stepper
nodes.norm_label: slider supplementation with text field and stepper
nodes.rationale: Supplement sliders with text fields and steppers to let users enter exact values or increment by whole steps across wide ranges.

nodes.label: Pairing Stepper with Text Field
nodes.rationale: Pair with text fields when large value changes are likely, giving users both direct numeric input and discrete tap increments.

nodes.label: Custom Indicator Images
nodes.rationale: Allows simple SF Symbols (e.g. location.fill in Weather) to highlight special pages, avoiding more than two distinct symbols.

nodes.label: Flat Sequential Navigation
nodes.rationale: Navigates ordered peer pages (ideally <=10 dots) centered at the bottom of the screen.

nodes.label: watchOS Vertical Pagination
nodes.rationale: Pairs page indicator with Digital Crown for vertical tab view navigation across purposeful single-screen pages.

nodes.label: visionOS Look to Scroll
nodes.rationale: Hands-free eye-tracking scrolling triggered near window boundaries in reading views.

nodes.label: Scroll Edge Effects
nodes.rationale: Visual separation (automatic, hard, or soft blur) between floating bars and scrolling content.

nodes.label: Toolbars

nodes.label: Mac Catalyst
nodes.rationale: Enables bringing iPad apps to macOS, providing automatic support for Mac pointer interactions, windowing, toolbars, and menus.

nodes.label: Design Principle: Agency
nodes.rationale: Let people do things their own way; give freedom to act, stay out of the way, and make mistake recovery effortless

nodes.label: Design Principle: Craft
nodes.rationale: Care about every detail; deliver high visual quality, smooth animations, precise copy, and continuous iteration

nodes.label: Design Principle: Delight
nodes.rationale: Make it human; evoke appropriate emotion and create defining moments without mistaking delight for mere decoration

nodes.label: Design Principle: Familiarity
nodes.rationale: Build on what people know; draw on real-world and platform patterns, keeping visuals, interactions, and feedback consistent

nodes.label: Design Principle: Flexibility
nodes.rationale: Adapt to diverse contexts, inputs, and needs; prioritize accessibility and preserve context across devices

nodes.label: Design Principle: Responsibility
nodes.rationale: Act in people's best interest; earn trust through transparency, safety, and rigorous privacy protection

nodes.label: Design Principle: Simplicity
nodes.rationale: Be clear and direct; remove the unnecessary, establish clear hierarchy, and use concise language

nodes.label: Catalyst Navigation Adaptation
nodes.rationale: Encourages transforming iPad tab bars into split views with sidebars or segmented controls, exposing top-level items in macOS View menu.

nodes.label: Floating Tab Bar on Liquid Glass
nodes.norm_label: floating tab bar on liquid glass
nodes.rationale: Floats above content on Liquid Glass background in iOS, with minimize behavior collapsing alongside accessories like MiniPlayer on scroll.

nodes.label: iPadOS Sidebar Adaptability
nodes.rationale: Top tab bar that can convert to a sidebar, supporting user customization with a recommended default of five or fewer tabs.

nodes.label: Top-Level Tab Bar Navigation
nodes.rationale: Navigates between primary app sections while preserving state; strictly separate from action bars or toolbars.

nodes.label: visionOS Vertical Expanding Tab Bar
nodes.rationale: Vertical bar pinned to window leading side showing symbols, expanding automatically on gaze hover to reveal text labels.

nodes.label: Tab Badges & Single-Word Labels
nodes.rationale: Use single-word labels with filled SF Symbols; restrict red notification badges to critical information to prevent visual fatigue.

nodes.label: Disclosure button
nodes.rationale: Single-control disclosure button pointing down when content is hidden and up when visible, as seen in macOS Save sheets.

nodes.label: Disclosure triangle
nodes.rationale: Progressive hierarchy disclosure indicator pointing inward when collapsed and down when visible, commonly used in Finder list view and Keynote export.

nodes.label: Disclosure controls
nodes.rationale: Controls that progressively disclose and hide information and functionality to prevent cognitive overload while keeping essential options visible.

nodes.label: Dynamic quick actions
nodes.rationale: Contextually updated shortcuts reflecting recent items, location, or time of day in predictable ways.

nodes.label: Quick action interface icons
nodes.rationale: Monochromatic SF Symbols or custom template icons providing instant visual recognition for quick actions.

nodes.label: Dock menus
nodes.rationale: macOS contextual menus revealed by secondary clicking an app icon in the Dock, presenting open windows and high-value background actions.

nodes.label: Home Screen quick actions
nodes.rationale: Menu of up to four high-value app shortcuts revealed by touching and holding an app icon on iOS and iPadOS.

nodes.label: Menus and Actions
nodes.rationale: Collection group organizing action initiation, context menus, bars, and action components.

nodes.label: Document launcher
nodes.rationale: Full-screen iOS 18/iPadOS 18 interface featuring a title card, themed background, accessories, and a file browser sheet for document creation.

nodes.label: Finder Sync extensions
nodes.rationale: macOS extension enabling cloud synchronization apps to show sync badges, custom contextual menus, and toolbar sync controls in Finder.

nodes.label: Quick Look previews
nodes.rationale: System preview mechanism allowing viewers and generators to render interactive file previews without launching external full applications.

nodes.label: File management
nodes.rationale: Document lifecycle management principles: continuous autosaving, predictable browsing via Files/Finder paradigms, and Quick Look previews.

nodes.label: Live Activity Lifecycle and Timely Updates
nodes.norm_label: live activity lifecycle and timely updates
nodes.rationale: Live Activities track real-time events over a few hours; updates must be significant and end cleanly when tasks conclude.

nodes.label: Dynamic Island Compact, Minimal, and Expanded Presentations
nodes.norm_label: dynamic island compact, minimal, and expanded presentations
nodes.rationale: Compact presentations split leading and trailing elements around the TrueDepth camera; minimal displays when multiple activities run; expanded reveals rich details.

nodes.label: Lock Screen and StandBy Presentations
nodes.rationale: Banner-style presentation on the Lock Screen and scaled, high-contrast glanceable layout in StandBy mode.

nodes.label: Multiplatform Live Activities Distribution
nodes.rationale: Live Activities automatically syndicate from iPhone to Apple Watch Smart Stack, Mac menu bar via iPhone Mirroring, and CarPlay Dashboard.

nodes.label: Glanceability vs Driving Safety in CarPlay
nodes.norm_label: glanceability vs driving safety in carplay
nodes.rationale: System deactivates interactive buttons in CarPlay to prioritize driver safety, requiring glanceable timely metrics.

nodes.label: Directional Control Flipping
nodes.rationale: Flipping progress/sliders and navigation back buttons, while preserving real-world physical directions.

nodes.label: Interface Icon Directionality
nodes.rationale: Flipping reading/motion icons while preserving logos, universal marks, clocks, and right-handed tools.

nodes.label: RTL Numeral Systems
nodes.rationale: Preserving digit order in numbers while reversing the order of numerals indicating progress.

nodes.label: SF Symbols RTL Variants
nodes.rationale: Built-in RTL variants and localized symbols in SF Symbols.

nodes.label: RTL Text Alignment
nodes.rationale: Aligning short text to interface direction while aligning full paragraphs to their native language.

nodes.label: Right to Left (RTL)
nodes.rationale: Reversing interfaces and adapting layouts, numerals, and typography for RTL scripts.

nodes.label: Search Field Placement
nodes.rationale: Search fields should receive primary positioning in views or dedicated tabs when search is critical to the app experience.

nodes.label: Search Suggestions & History
nodes.rationale: Provide predictive search suggestions and recent queries while respecting user privacy and offering clear history deletion.

nodes.label: Spotlight Systemwide Search
nodes.rationale: Index app content and custom file metadata so items are discoverable from systemwide Spotlight searches without opening the app first.

nodes.label: Search Scope and Filtering
nodes.rationale: Clearly display the active search scope using scope bars, tokens, or titles to avoid confusing results across distinct content domains.

nodes.label: Thin Divider Styling & Resizing
nodes.rationale: Prefer 1pt thin dividers for maximum content area while maintaining sensible minimum and maximum pane resizing limits.

nodes.label: Platform Split View Adaptations
nodes.rationale: 2 or 3 panes in iPadOS; vertical/horizontal combinations in macOS; content filtering in tvOS; full-screen list/detail with vertical tabs in watchOS.

nodes.label: Split View Multi-Pane Navigation
nodes.rationale: Coordinates adjacent panes (primary, secondary, optional tertiary) showing multiple levels of hierarchy with persistent selection highlighting.

nodes.label: visionOS Supplementary Information
nodes.rationale: Use split views rather than spawning secondary windows in visionOS to keep supplementary data accessible without disorienting window sprawl.

nodes.label: Share and Action Extensions
nodes.rationale: App extensions that provide custom share destinations and content-specific tasks within the system share sheet across apps.

nodes.label: AirPlay Icon Usage and Branding
nodes.rationale: Use official black/white/custom-color AirPlay icons in noninteractive ways; use AirPlay as a noun and emphasize the app over AirPlay.

nodes.label: AirPlay Playback Continuity
nodes.rationale: Maintain background streaming when the app backgrounds or the device locks, avoiding interrupting ongoing audio/video sessions.

nodes.label: Activity Views (Share Sheet)
nodes.rationale: Presents a range of sharing services and contextual actions accessible via the standard Share button.

nodes.label: AirPlay
nodes.rationale: Wireless media streaming and mirroring technology allowing people to stream video and audio across Apple devices.

nodes.label: App Icon Appearance Variants
nodes.rationale: Icon designs supporting Default, Dark, Clear, and Tinted rendering modes while maintaining recognizability across platforms.

nodes.label: Layered App Icon Architecture
nodes.rationale: Multi-layered icon structure authored in Icon Composer enabling system dynamic visual effects like Liquid Glass, 3D parallax, and depth.

nodes.label: Subtle Brand Integration
nodes.rationale: Incorporate branding through voice, tone, and judicious accent color rather than distracting logos or oversized badges in navigation.

nodes.label: App Icons
nodes.rationale: Visual identity asset representing an app across Home Screen, Dock, App Store, Spotlight, and notifications.

nodes.label: Branding
nodes.rationale: Guidelines for expressing unique product identity across apps and games without compromising standard platform usability.

nodes.label: Status feedback
nodes.rationale: Passive, non-disruptive information embedded in toolbars or views showing current state without interrupting user flow.

nodes.label: visionOS Custom Environments and Ground Plane
nodes.norm_label: visionos custom environments and ground plane
nodes.rationale: Include ground plane meshes and lighting shaders to prevent disorientation and claustrophobia; avoid flat 360-degree static image spheres.

nodes.label: visionOS Immersion Styles (Mixed, Progressive, Full)
nodes.rationale: Mixed immersion blends 3D objects with passthrough; progressive replaces part of passthrough adjustable via Digital Crown; full creates a 360-degree environment.

nodes.label: visionOS Shared Space vs Full Space
nodes.norm_label: visionos shared space vs full space
nodes.rationale: Apps launch alongside others in Shared Space or transition into Full Space where sole focus and unbounded 3D experiences occur.

nodes.label: Virtual Hands Representation
nodes.rationale: Render virtual hands at true-to-life scale matching user gestures; fade out cleanly to real hands if hand tracking is interrupted.

nodes.label: System Launch Screens
nodes.rationale: In iOS, iPadOS, and tvOS, a launch screen visually mimics the first screen to prevent jarring visual flashes during initialization.

nodes.label: App State Restoration on Launch
nodes.rationale: Restore exact previous document positions, scroll offsets, and open windows so users seamlessly continue their work.

nodes.label: Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and Cloud DVR
nodes.norm_label: electronic program guide (epg) and cloud dvr
nodes.rationale: Facilitate browsing scheduled broadcasts with Picture-in-Picture continuation and flexible series/team cloud DVR scheduling.

nodes.label: Background Assets Framework for Non-Disruptive Downloads
nodes.norm_label: background assets framework for non-disruptive downloads
nodes.rationale: Leverage BackgroundAssets framework to download game assets and 3D models post-installation without blocking user startup.

nodes.label: Determinate vs Indeterminate Progress Indicators
nodes.rationale: Use determinate indicators when duration is quantifiable, and indeterminate spinning indicators when task length is unknown.

nodes.label: Passkeys and Biometric Authentication
nodes.rationale: Eliminates password entry via passkeys and biometric authentication; avoids redundant in-app biometric toggles.

nodes.label: TV Provider Authentication
nodes.rationale: Uses system-level TV provider credentials on Apple TV to eliminate redundant app-by-app sign-in.

nodes.label: Feedback Animation Principles
nodes.rationale: Keeps animations brief, precise, directional, cancelable, and avoids animating repetitive UI actions.

nodes.label: Continuous Proximity Feedback
nodes.rationale: Transitions dynamically across visual (arrow to pulsing circle), haptic, and audio modalities as proximity sharpens.

nodes.label: Physical Proximity and Spatial Context
nodes.rationale: Roots digital actions in physical proximity (e.g. holding iPhone near HomePod mini to transfer playback).

nodes.label: TipKit Tips
nodes.rationale: Transient views (popover, annotation, hint) for simple features (<=3 steps) controlled by eligibility rules.

nodes.label: Tooltips and Help Tags
nodes.rationale: Brief (60-75 chars), sentence-case descriptions appearing on pointer hover or gaze without repeating control names.

nodes.label: Contextual Onboarding Tips
nodes.rationale: Distributes context-specific tips throughout usage instead of forcing a monolithic tutorial flow.

nodes.label: Feedback
nodes.rationale: Delivering clear, consistent status, confirmation, warnings, and error recovery matched to significance across sensory channels.

nodes.label: Managing Accounts
nodes.rationale: Guidance for account creation, authentication, passkeys, and mandatory account deletion flows.

nodes.label: Motion
nodes.rationale: Fluid animation bringing interfaces to life, communicating status, feedback, and instruction.

nodes.label: Nearby Interactions
nodes.rationale: On-device spatial experiences integrating presence of nearby people and objects using Ultra Wideband (UWB) technology.

nodes.label: Offering Help
nodes.rationale: Contextual assistance patterns including TipKit tips and system tooltips.

nodes.label: Onboarding
nodes.rationale: Fast, enjoyable, and optional introduction to an app or game.

nodes.label: Multimodal feedback
nodes.rationale: Employing multiple sensory channels (color, text, sound, haptics) so feedback remains effective under device silence, low vision, or distraction.

nodes.label: Passthrough and Safety Boundary Management
nodes.rationale: A 1.5-meter head movement boundary and automatic opacity adjustments protect users from physical collisions while in immersion.

nodes.label: Instant Launch and Perception of Speed
nodes.norm_label: instant launch and perception of speed
nodes.rationale: Launch experience should complete within seconds; downplay splash branding in favor of immediate functional readiness.

nodes.label: Instant Live Playback and Contextual Audio
nodes.norm_label: instant live playback and contextual audio
nodes.rationale: Begin playing broadcast content immediately upon launch; stop audio cleanly whenever users navigate away from the live tab.

nodes.label: Placeholder Content and Perceived Loading Speed
nodes.norm_label: placeholder content and perceived loading speed
nodes.rationale: Show placeholder graphics and let users interact with available features while data loads to eliminate the perception of system hanging.

nodes.label: In-App Account Deletion
nodes.rationale: Mandates providing direct account deletion within the app or via prominent link, revoking tokens and explaining billing implications.

nodes.label: Delayed Sign-In
nodes.rationale: Delays mandatory sign-in until essential functionality is accessed to minimize onboarding abandonment.

nodes.label: Purposeful and Optional Motion
nodes.rationale: Avoids gratuitous animation, provides haptic/audio alternatives, and respects Reduce Motion accessibility settings.

nodes.label: Device Handling and Line-of-Sight
nodes.rationale: Portrait orientation aligns device sensor field-of-view; accounts for intervening obstacles degrading precision.

nodes.label: Interactive Learning
nodes.rationale: Teaches through actual interaction and play rather than passive text; avoids large upfront downloads.

nodes.label: Permission Requests in Onboarding
nodes.rationale: Clearly articulates user benefits before requesting access to private data during initial setup.

nodes.label: Collaboration Button
nodes.rationale: Prominently indicates content is shared, displays active collaborators, and offers communication

nodes.label: Collaboration Popover
nodes.rationale: Presents collaborators, communication actions, custom app activities, and file management controls

nodes.label: Share Button
nodes.rationale: Convenient toolbar entry point to initiate file sharing or collaboration

nodes.label: Share Sheet
nodes.rationale: System-provided interface for choosing sharing method and setting collaboration permissions

nodes.label: Collection Views
nodes.rationale: Manage ordered sets of content in customizable and visual row or grid layouts, ideal for image-based content

nodes.label: Collection Grid Layout
nodes.rationale: Standard expected layout for browsing image items with adequate padding for focus/hover

nodes.label: Browser (Column View)
nodes.rationale: Vertical multi-column view for navigating deep hierarchical data back and forth, like macOS Finder

nodes.label: Gauge accessory variant
nodes.rationale: Circular or linear gauge style echoing watchOS complications, tailored for iOS Lock Screen widgets.

nodes.label: Level indicators
nodes.rationale: macOS indicator displaying continuous or discrete capacity, ratings, or relevance along a horizontal bar.

nodes.label: Gauges
nodes.rationale: Visual indicators showing a specific numerical value within a range along circular or linear paths in standard or capacity styles.

nodes.label: Activity rings
nodes.rationale: Three-ring visual element strictly displaying Move, Exercise, and Stand progress for a single user without ornamentation or branding use.

nodes.label: Apple Health icon
nodes.rationale: Unmodifiable Apple-provided icon denoting Apple Health compatibility, accompanied by exact editorial naming.

nodes.label: HealthKit
nodes.rationale: Central repository for health and fitness metrics across iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS with strict privacy gating and Apple Health branding rules.

nodes.label: HealthKit privacy protection
nodes.rationale: Strict privacy mandate requiring explicit context-dependent authorization, coherent privacy policy, and exclusive routing through system settings.

nodes.label: Photo Editing Extensions
nodes.rationale: Extensions run within a modal view in Photos to provide custom filters and adjustments.

nodes.label: Photo Editing
nodes.rationale: Photo-editing extensions let people modify photos and videos within the Photos app.

nodes.label: Nondestructive Editing
nodes.rationale: Edits are always saved as new files in the Photos app, safely preserving original versions.

nodes.label: Request Review Prompt
nodes.rationale: System-provided prompt rate-limited to 3 times per 365 days after user engagement.

nodes.label: Rating Indicators
nodes.rationale: Uses horizontally arranged symbols (stars) to communicate ranking levels in macOS.

nodes.label: Ratings and Reviews
nodes.rationale: Requesting user ratings and App Store reviews at engaged, non-disruptive moments.

nodes.label: Active Tasks & Surveys
nodes.rationale: Motor/speech/cognitive activities and single-question survey screens.

nodes.label: Informed Consent & Quizzes
nodes.rationale: Digestible sections explaining data gathering, comprehension quizzes, and legal signature.

nodes.label: ResearchKit Onboarding Flow
nodes.rationale: Sequential flow: Introduction -> Eligibility -> Informed consent -> Permission to access data.

nodes.label: ResearchKit
nodes.rationale: Framework for designing medical research apps with standardized onboarding, consent, and tasks.

nodes.label: macOS Settings Window & Panes
nodes.rationale: Standard Command-Comma shortcut, toolbar panes indicating active section, dimmed minimize/maximize buttons, and persistent pane restoration.

nodes.label: Default Settings Optimization
nodes.rationale: Provide defaults giving the best experience to the most people without manual setup; minimize the total number of settings offered.

nodes.label: Task-Specific Options vs Global Settings
nodes.rationale: Keep task-specific options in the context of the task itself rather than disconnecting users by sending them to a separate settings pane.

nodes.label: Adaptable Sidebar Style
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI sidebarAdaptable style converts between tab bar and sidebar depending on device width, orientation, and user preference.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass Background Extension
nodes.rationale: Extends rich visual content beneath the floating Liquid Glass sidebar via horizontal scrolling or background extension effects.

nodes.label: Sidebar Navigation Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Leading view for top-level app navigation, optimal with no more than 2 levels of hierarchy and disclosure controls for deep data structures.

nodes.label: Edit Menu
nodes.rationale: Commands for modifying content and clipboard operations including Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste

nodes.label: Shake to Undo
nodes.rationale: Accelerometer-triggered motion gesture on iPhone presenting an undo confirmation alert

nodes.label: Undo and Redo
nodes.rationale: Mechanism allowing users to reverse and restore actions, enabling safe exploration

nodes.label: Multi-Step & Batch Undo
nodes.rationale: Allow multiple undo operations back to document opening and grouping related micro-edits

nodes.label: Undo Target Clarification
nodes.rationale: Explicitly naming the action in undo labels (e.g. Undo Typing) prevents user confusion

nodes.label: Destructive Action Presentation
nodes.rationale: Destructive actions must use destructive styling and be placed prominently at the top of the action sheet, paired with a clear Cancel button at the bottom.

nodes.label: Alert Button Conventions
nodes.rationale: Use succinct action-oriented button titles (1-2 words), always include Cancel for dismissal, and use OK only for purely informational notices.

nodes.label: Alert Minimization and Sparingness
nodes.rationale: Alerts disrupt tasks; use sparingly for unexpected problems or irreversible actions, never for common undoable tasks or pure information.

nodes.label: Button Semantic Roles
nodes.rationale: Roles (Normal, Primary, Cancel, Destructive) govern visual styling, keyboard shortcuts (Return key response), and safety warnings.

nodes.label: Button Visual Styles and Prominence
nodes.rationale: Use prominent filled styles for preferred choices and subtle styles for secondary options; maintain consistent button sizes.

nodes.label: Focus Integration
nodes.rationale: Enables notifications to respect user focus modes (Work, Sleep, Personal) while permitting allowed contacts and Time Sensitive alerts.

nodes.label: Interruption Levels
nodes.rationale: Four system levels: Passive (leisure), Active (default), Time Sensitive (breaks Focus), and Critical (requires entitlement, overrides Ring/Silent).

nodes.label: Full-Screen Modal Presentation
nodes.rationale: Fills window or display for immersive experiences (photo editing, markup) or transitions to Full Space in visionOS.

nodes.label: App Icon Badging
nodes.rationale: Indicates unread notification count on app icon; must be updated immediately and never used for arbitrary numbers.

nodes.label: Actionable Notifications
nodes.rationale: Up to 4 contextual buttons for fast tasks without opening app; distinguishes destructive actions visually.

nodes.label: Notification Anatomy
nodes.rationale: Consists of app icon/avatar, title, body content, and optional sound/badges; handles foreground arrival silently.

nodes.label: watchOS Short Looks and Long Looks
nodes.norm_label: watchos short looks and long looks
nodes.rationale: Short looks appear briefly on wrist raise; scrollable long looks offer rich interactive custom interfaces with double-tap support.

nodes.label: macOS Detachable Popover
nodes.rationale: In macOS, a popover can be dragged away into an independent floating panel.

nodes.label: Popover Transience
nodes.rationale: Popovers disappear on interaction outside; work is auto-saved and popovers never cascade.

nodes.label: Action Sheets
nodes.rationale: Modal view displaying contextual choices in response to an intentional action initiated by the user.

nodes.label: Alerts
nodes.rationale: Urgent modal dialogs giving critical information and demanding immediate confirmation or action.

nodes.label: Buttons
nodes.rationale: Fundamental interactive components that initiate instantaneous actions across all Apple platforms.

nodes.label: Managing Notifications
nodes.rationale: Strategies for delivering timely notifications while respecting user attention via Focus and delivery scheduling.

nodes.label: Modality
nodes.rationale: Design technique presenting content in a dedicated mode that prevents parent view interaction and requires explicit dismissal.

nodes.label: Notifications
nodes.rationale: Delivers timely, high-value information glanceable across lock screens, banners, and Notification Center.

nodes.label: Popovers
nodes.rationale: A transient view appearing above other content to expose a small amount of information or tasks.

nodes.label: Marketing Notifications Policy
nodes.rationale: Strictly requires explicit opt-in and in-app management; must never use Time Sensitive interruption level.

nodes.label: Modal Dismissal and Data Protection
nodes.rationale: Provides obvious dismiss controls and requires confirmation before closing if user data loss could occur.

nodes.label: Modal Purpose and Scope
nodes.rationale: Used only when necessary to ensure people receive critical information, confirm actions, or perform a narrowly scoped task.

nodes.label: Modal Simplicity
nodes.rationale: Keeps modal tasks short, avoids multi-layered view hierarchies that feel like an app within an app, and never stacks modal views.

nodes.label: Carousel Actions Layout
nodes.rationale: Full-screen carousel layout with Play and More Info action buttons

nodes.label: Carousel Details Layout
nodes.rationale: Extended carousel layout presenting plot synopsis, cast lists, and content metadata

nodes.label: Scrolling Inset Banner
nodes.rationale: Full-width timed scrolling banner with remote-driven 3D layered parallax depth

nodes.label: Sectioned Content Row
nodes.rationale: Single horizontal row of focusable poster, square, or 16:9 media cards

nodes.label: Top Shelf
nodes.rationale: Showcase area at top of Apple TV Home Screen displaying previews, trailers, and shortcuts

nodes.label: HomeKit Object Model Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Models the home as a hierarchy of homes, rooms, zones, accessories, services, and characteristics to give people intuitive control across voice, app, and automation.

nodes.label: HomeKit Scenes and Automations
nodes.rationale: Scenes group actions controlling multiple services across accessories, while automations trigger accessories based on time, location, or sensor events.

nodes.label: HomeKit Naming and Trademark Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Emphasize the app over HomeKit, avoid using HomeKit as a descriptor or verb, and maintain Apple trademark accuracy.

nodes.label: Accessibility Across Permanent, Temporary, and Situational Disabilities
nodes.norm_label: accessibility across permanent, temporary, and situational disabilities
nodes.rationale: Disabilities exist on a spectrum affecting everyone across life stages, illnesses, or noisy/distracting environments.

nodes.label: Avoiding Biases, Assumptions, and Cultural Stereotypes
nodes.norm_label: avoiding biases, assumptions, and cultural stereotypes
nodes.rationale: Unconscious biases narrow design thinking; avoid culture-specific or capability-specific assumptions in security questions and UI copy.

nodes.label: Portraying Human Diversity and Authentic Settings
nodes.norm_label: portraying human diversity and authentic settings
nodes.rationale: Depict a broad range of human characteristics, ages, races, and relatable life settings without perpetuating stereotypes or assumed affluence.

nodes.label: Page Setup Dialog
nodes.rationale: Document-specific page configuration including paper size, orientation, and scaling.

nodes.label: Printing
nodes.rationale: Integrating system print functionality with custom printer- and document-specific options.

nodes.label: Clickpad Gestures
nodes.rationale: Swiping for scrolling/changing focus, pressing for activation/scrubbing.

nodes.label: EPG & Channel Navigation
nodes.rationale: Guide and page up/down buttons on compatible remotes for electronic program guides.

nodes.label: Remotes (Siri Remote)
nodes.rationale: Primary input device for Apple TV combining touch surface, clickpad, and dedicated buttons.

nodes.label: ShazamKit Audio Recognition
nodes.rationale: Matches short audio samples against ShazamKit catalog or custom catalogs to synchronize experiences, accessibility captions, and retail/education features.

nodes.label: Microphone Recording Privacy
nodes.rationale: Explicitly inform users why microphone access is needed, stop recording as soon as match completes, and require opt-in to save to iCloud library.

nodes.label: Activity Rings Summary
nodes.rationale: Session completion view incorporating official Apple Activity rings to confirm goal progress

nodes.label: Workout Metrics Screen
nodes.rationale: Real-time updating dashboard showing elapsed time, active calories, heart rate, and pace

nodes.label: Workout Sessions
nodes.rationale: Active tracking sessions keeping the app active between wrist raises with large tappable controls

nodes.label: Workouts
nodes.rationale: Active physical activity tracking and fitness metrics experience on Apple Watch and iOS

nodes.label: AR Coaching Overlay
nodes.rationale: Standard ARCoachingOverlayView that guides users through surface detection, lighting calibration, and device tracking.

nodes.label: AR Direct Manipulation
nodes.rationale: Prioritize direct touch and gestures on virtual 3D models over screen-space controls, grounding object motions in real-world physics.

nodes.label: Augmented Reality
nodes.rationale: ARKit-powered experiences that blend virtual 3D objects and spatial experiences seamlessly with the physical world.

nodes.label: CarPlay Audio Session Management
nodes.rationale: Respect vehicle audio ecosystems; delay session initialization until ready to avoid cutting off the car radio, and resume only from temporary interruptions.

nodes.label: Driver Safety and Glanceable Layout
nodes.rationale: Minimize distraction by eliminating iPhone interactions while driving, placing primary content high onscreen, and using high-contrast layouts.

nodes.label: CarPlay
nodes.rationale: In-vehicle interface system bringing essential iPhone features (navigation, audio, messaging, calling) safely to car displays.

nodes.label: iMessage Compact vs Expanded Presentation
nodes.rationale: Compact view presents essential, quick-access actions below message transcripts; expanded view accommodates text editing and comprehensive features.

nodes.label: iMessage Sticker Packs and Specifications
nodes.rationale: Sticker packs provide expressive illustrations at small, regular, or large grid dimensions with accessibility voiceover descriptions.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass Variants
nodes.rationale: Regular variant blurs and balances background luminosity; Clear variant provides high translucency for media backgrounds with optional 35% dimming layer.

nodes.label: HUD-Style Panels
nodes.rationale: Dark, translucent floating panel for media-oriented or full-screen apps where standard panels obscure visual content.

nodes.label: Inspector and Auxiliary Panels
nodes.rationale: Dynamically updates contents to reflect selection; automatically brings to front when app activates and hides when inactive.

nodes.label: Checkbox
nodes.rationale: Square toggle button indicating selected, deselected, or mixed states; supports hierarchy

nodes.label: Radio Buttons
nodes.rationale: Mutually exclusive circular selection controls presented in groups of two to five choices

nodes.label: Switch Toggle
nodes.rationale: Visual sliding toggle style used predominantly in list rows and for primary settings

nodes.label: Toggle-Style Button
nodes.rationale: Button with alternate background appearances indicating active and inactive states

nodes.label: Toggles
nodes.rationale: Binary state controls enabling people to choose between opposing states like on and off

nodes.label: Watch Face Previews
nodes.rationale: Device bezel artwork framing shared watch faces for marketing and web displays

nodes.label: Watch Face Sharing
nodes.rationale: Feature allowing users and developers to share curated watch face setups via web or messages

nodes.label: Watch Faces
nodes.rationale: Primary timekeeping and complication view on watchOS raised on wrist raise

nodes.label: Accessory Widgets
nodes.rationale: Accessory Circular, Corner, Inline, and Rectangular widgets for Lock Screen and complications

nodes.label: Interactive Widgets
nodes.rationale: Widgets embedding buttons and toggles to complete tasks without launching the host app

nodes.label: Widget Rendering Modes
nodes.rationale: Visual rendering modes: Full-color, Accented (tinted/clear Liquid Glass), and Vibrant (Lock Screen)

nodes.label: StandBy and CarPlay Widgets
nodes.rationale: Small system widgets with background removed and content scaled up for distant glanceability

nodes.label: System Family Widgets
nodes.rationale: Standard widget sizes: Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large, and Extra Large Portrait

nodes.label: visionOS Spatial Widgets
nodes.rationale: 3D persistent widgets placed on horizontal/vertical surfaces with distance proximity thresholds

nodes.label: Widget Mounting Styles
nodes.rationale: Elevated mounting style (gently tilted or flush with shadow) vs recessed mounting style (wall cutout)

nodes.label: Widget Treatment Styles
nodes.rationale: Paper style (grounded print-like reacting to ambient lighting) vs Glass style (crisp layered contrast)

nodes.label: Widgets
nodes.rationale: Glanceable views displaying timely content and micro-interactions across Apple platforms

nodes.label: macOS Window States
nodes.rationale: Main, Key (active), and Inactive window states with distinct visual depth and vibrancy

nodes.label: Primary and Auxiliary Windows
nodes.rationale: Primary windows for main navigation and content; auxiliary windows for dedicated single tasks

nodes.label: visionOS 2D Windows
nodes.rationale: Default glass plane windows displaying 2D and 3D UI content with dynamic distance scaling

nodes.label: Volume Baseplate Glow
nodes.rationale: Subtle horizontal floor glow in visionOS 2 clarifying volumetric bounds when looked at

nodes.label: Volumetric Windows (Volumes)
nodes.rationale: Translucent cube in visionOS displaying bounded 3D content viewable from any angle

nodes.label: Windows
nodes.rationale: Container presentation view defining app visual boundaries and enabling multitasking workflows

nodes.label: Panels
nodes.rationale: Floating auxiliary window in macOS providing supplementary controls or information related to active window.

nodes.label: Background Tag Reading
nodes.rationale: Scans tags automatically when screen is illuminated, presenting notification banners to launch matching apps.

nodes.label: In-App NFC Tag Reading
nodes.rationale: Displays scanning sheet using approachable terms ('scan', 'hold near') rather than technical jargon ('NFC', 'tap').

nodes.label: NFC (Near-Field Communication)
nodes.rationale: Short-range wireless communication within centimeters to read electronic tags attached to real-world objects.

nodes.label: Web View Navigation Controls
nodes.rationale: Forward and back buttons enabling multi-page web browsing within an in-app web view

nodes.label: Web Views
nodes.rationale: WebKit view loading and displaying HTML and online web content inline within an app

nodes.label: In-App Web Browsing Policy
nodes.rationale: Use web views for brief context-preserving webpage visits, not for rebuilding Safari

nodes.label: Activity Rings Visual Integrity
nodes.rationale: Never modify ring colors, opacity, or backgrounds; always display on a black background and preserve minimum outer margins.

nodes.label: Activity Rings
nodes.rationale: Standard visual progress indicator for daily Move, Exercise, and Stand goals, strictly preserved across watchOS and iOS.

nodes.label: Always On Privacy Redaction
nodes.rationale: Redact sensitive personal data (health, finance), dim secondary elements, and smoothly transition animations to a resting state.

nodes.label: Always On
nodes.rationale: Low-power display mode on iPhone and Apple Watch that preserves glanceable information while the user is not actively interacting.

nodes.label: Visual Grouping and Containment
nodes.rationale: Keep boxes relatively small compared to containing views; use padding and alignment to structure elements before adding extra outlines.

nodes.label: Boxes (GroupBox / NSBox)
nodes.rationale: Visual grouping container using borders or background fills to establish visual relationships among closely related controls.

nodes.label: Design fundamentals
nodes.rationale: Underlying principles establishing visual hierarchy, sensory feedback, spatial comfort, and behavioral consistency.

nodes.label: Foundations
nodes.rationale: Collection of fundamental design elements (accessibility, color, layout, materials, typography, etc.) forming the core design vocabulary of Apple platforms.

nodes.label: Platform adaptation
nodes.rationale: Aligning app architecture and interactions with each Apple platform's ergonomics, mobility, and spatial capabilities.

nodes.label: Getting started
nodes.rationale: High-level orientation hub guiding platform-specific design adaptation across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS.

nodes.label: Gyroscope and accelerometer
nodes.rationale: Hardware sensors supplying real-time physical movement and orientation data in iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, and Siri Remote.

nodes.label: Status Indicators Collection
nodes.rationale: Collection of controls and indicators communicating progress, activity levels, quantitative metrics, and ratings.

nodes.label: Patterns Collection
nodes.rationale: Design guidance collection for supporting common user actions, tasks, and experiences.

nodes.label: Digital Crown Navigation
nodes.rationale: Primary navigation modality in watchOS 10+ for moving between Smart Stack widgets, lists, variable height pages, and vertical tabs.

nodes.label: Digital Crown Haptic Detents
nodes.rationale: Tactile rotational feedback via default linear or row-based taps matching distance turned or list items.

nodes.label: Digital Crown Immersion Control
nodes.rationale: Rotational control on Apple Vision Pro to adjust immersion level, volume, recenter content, open accessibility settings, or exit to Home View.

nodes.label: Custom hover effects
nodes.rationale: Predefined dual-state visual animations configured with delays (none, short, long) executed out-of-process when looked at.

nodes.label: Hover effect
nodes.rationale: System-rendered out-of-process visual feedback that highlights interactive elements when looked at without exposing gaze coordinates to apps.

nodes.label: Focus groups
nodes.rationale: Navigational zones in iPadOS traversed via Tab key between groups and arrow keys within a group.

nodes.label: Halo effect
nodes.rationale: Focus ring outlining focused items, customizable to match corner radiuses or Bézier paths in iPadOS and visionOS.

nodes.label: tvOS focus states
nodes.rationale: Five visual states (unfocused, focused, highlighted, selected, unavailable) utilizing parallax depth and elevation on Apple TV.

nodes.label: Standard gestures
nodes.rationale: Cross-platform gesture vocabulary: Tap, Swipe, Drag, Touch/pinch and hold, Double tap, Zoom, and Rotate.

nodes.label: visionOS system overlay gestures
nodes.rationale: Palm-facing gestures reserved for Home and Control Center overlays, deferrable in immersive Full Space experiences.

nodes.label: visionOS indirect and direct gestures
nodes.rationale: Indirect gestures pairing gaze with finger-thumb tap at a distance, and direct gestures physically touching virtual objects within reach.

nodes.label: watchOS double tap
nodes.rationale: One-handed gesture in watchOS 11+ for navigating lists, paging vertical tabs, or triggering primary actions in nonscrolling views.

nodes.label: System gesture deferral
nodes.rationale: Requiring two edge swipes to reveal the Home indicator or Dock during full-screen games, preventing accidental app dismissal.

nodes.label: Digital Crown
nodes.rationale: Hardware input on Apple Vision Pro and Apple Watch providing precise rotational control and navigation without obscuring the screen.

nodes.label: Eyes input
nodes.rationale: Primary targeting mechanism in visionOS where eye gaze identifies targets and triggers system hover effects while preserving user privacy from app processes.

nodes.label: Focus and selection
nodes.rationale: Component-based navigation system visually confirming targeted elements via keyboard, remote, or game controller input.

nodes.label: Gestures
nodes.rationale: Physical motions across touchscreens, air gestures, trackpads, and remotes that directly manipulate UI objects.

nodes.label: Going full screen
nodes.rationale: Expanding windows to fill the display on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, hiding system controls for distraction-free media or gameplay.

nodes.label: Visual comfort
nodes.rationale: Design guidance requiring elements within field of view, placed at least 1m away, rounded shapes (to prevent corner gaze trapping), and at least 16pt margins.
